mapper.select: SELECT /*+ INDEX(TB_ORD_H IDX_ORD_01) */ PY.PAYMENT_ID AS payNo, PY.AMOUNT AS payAmt, 'TB_ORD_H.ORD_NO' AS srcLabel, -- TB_ORD_H.ORD_NO 는 주석이라 그대로 L.ORD_NO AS logOrdNo FROM BILLING.PAYMENT PY JOIN ORDERS H ON H.ORDER_ID = PY.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LOG L ON L.ORD_NO = H.ORDER_ID WHERE PY.PAID_AT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt}
SELECT STATUS, MSG FROM ORDERS H JOIN TB_LOG L ON L.ORD_NO = H.ORDER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER C, PRODUCT P WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
